sn45.146-148:1.1: seyyathāpi bhikkhave yā kāci tārakarūpānaṃ pabhā sabbā tā candimāpabhāya kalaṃ nāgghanti soḷasiṃ candappabhā tāsaṃ aggamakkhāyati.
sn45.146-148:2.1: seyyathāpi bhikkhave saradasamaye viddhe vigatavalāhake deve ādicco nabhaṃ abbhussakkamāno sabbaṃ ākāsagataṃ tamagataṃ abhivihacca bhāsate ca tapate ca virocati ca.
sn45.146-148:3.1: seyyathāpi bhikkhave yāni kānici tantāvutānaṃ vatthānaṃ kāsikavatthaṃ tesaṃ aggamakkhāyati.
sn45.146-148:3.2: evameva kho bhikkhave ye keci kusalā dhammā sabbe te appamādamūlakā appamādasamosaraṇā
sn45.146-148:3.4: apapamattassetaṃ bhikkhave bhikkhuno pāṭikaṅkhaṃ ariyaṃ aṭṭhaṅgikaṃ maggaṃ bhāvessati ariyaṃ aṭṭhaṅgikaṃ maggaṃ bahulīkarissatīti.
sn45.146-148:3.5: kathañca bhikkhave bhikkhu appamatto ariyaṃ aṭṭhaṅgikaṃ maggaṃ bhāveti ariyaṃ aṭṭhaṅgikaṃ maggaṃ bahulīkaroti.
sn45.146-148:3.6: idha bhikkhave bhikkhu sammādiṭṭhiṃ bhāveti vivekanissitaṃ virāganissitaṃ nirodhanissitaṃ vossaggapariṇāmiṃ. pe. sammāsamādhiṃ bhāveti vivekanissitaṃ virāganissitaṃ nirodhanissitaṃ vossaggapariṇāmiṃ.
sn45.146-148:3.7: evaṃ kho bhikkhave bhikkhu appamatto ariyaṃ aṭṭhaṅgikaṃ maggaṃ bhāveti ariyaṃ aṭṭhaṅgikaṃ maggaṃ bahulīkarotīti.
